question.text: STCG on listed equity (held < 12 months, post Jul 2024):

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-July 2024, STCG rate on listed equity is 20% (up from 15%). The Trap: Older 15% doesn't apply. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XIX-A, X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Advise clients to hold > 12 months when possible — STCG is 20% vs LTCG 12.5%.
